head: codex/5701-runtime-v3-openapi-contracts
title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][api] Define Runtime v3 OpenAPI contracts (#5701)
body:
Closes #5701
Closes #5718

## Summary

Defines the complete versioned Runtime v3 Core and Observatory OpenAPI 3.1 contracts and serves them from the guardian-launched Axum/Tokio/Rustls listener. Health, metrics, and Observatory reads are public. Observatory writes require an explicit operator login, and signed control commands remain subject to runtime signature, principal, capability, identity, and command-policy verification. The separate HTML Observatory client supports public live reads plus login, logout, and signed command submission. Its visible product branding now identifies Runtime v3 rather than the retained v0.91.7 evidence baseline.

## Validation

- Kernel control routes: 21/21 passed.
- OpenAPI contract suite: 6/6 passed.
- Observatory WSS: 6/6 passed, including anonymous feed, real login elevation, pre-login write rejection, post-login signed Snapshot acceptance, invalid-login read continuity, and token-rotation revocation.
- Guardian soak: 7/7 passed.
- Strict all-target Clippy passed for adl-runtime-kernel.
- HTML Observatory integrated proof passed with the Runtime v3 chip and live Observatory heading.
- Live Guardian served anonymous health, metrics, and Observatory data on port 20997.
- Exact GPT-5.5 review of the branding correction passed with zero findings.

## Security boundary

Reads do not require a session token. Writes require login. The browser does not generate or retain a signing key; it transmits a pre-signed command envelope, and Runtime v3 performs the authoritative cryptographic and policy checks.
